svg.title: Where evalopt-graph sits: Your host runs the checks and supplies the observations; the kernel applies the policy and returns one of five outcomes.
svg.desc: Two lanes. Host lane: the host runs the checks (tests, lint → PASS/FAIL), detects weakened tests (tests_weakened=True), collects evidence (claims · attestations); it holds the GovernancePolicy (gates, trust, freshness) and builds an AcceptanceInput (immutable observation). Evalopt does not run checks or discover weakened tests. Kernel lane: evaluate_acceptance(policy, input) is pure: same policy + input → same decision; no LLM in the loop · fail-closed defaults. It returns an AcceptanceDecision · status, reasons, hashes, in one of five states: ACCEPTED (policy_satisfied), BLOCKED (tests_weakened), FAILED (required_gate_failed:tests), UNSUPPORTED (required_gate_unavailable:tests), UNVERIFIED (central_claim_unverified:c1). The host stores policy, input and decision. Later, replay(policy, input) recomputes the decision; True only if identical: consistency with the stored input, not its truth.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
